name: Bot Items Board
description: A wide board of every Orca bot's Items by status, narrowed by request (chat), with each Needs you question, its history and the bot's suggested replies one click away. English and Japanese.

cover.alt: The Bot Items Board: a request list and six status columns of bot Items, Planned first, two of them waiting on the owner

screenshots.alt: The request list on the left and six status columns of Items from four demo bots, Planned first
screenshots.caption: Every bot's Items, with the requests they belong to

screenshots.alt: The board narrowed to the Release v2.3 request, a group room with two bots, chosen in the list
screenshots.caption: Choose a request to narrow the board

screenshots.alt: A Needs you Item in a floating box: summary, history, info column, two questions with suggested replies, and an Answer in Orca button
screenshots.caption: A Needs you Item with its questions and suggested replies

screenshots.alt: The same floating box scrolled to the end of the Item's history, with the bot's question and status changes
screenshots.caption: The history behind the question

settings.title: orca CLI path
settings.description: The orca executable the worker runs to read Items. Empty: find it on PATH and in Orca's CLI shim folder.

settings.title: Refresh every (seconds)
settings.description: How often the open panel reloads the board. Orca has no Item events for plugins yet.

settings.title: Open the board on first run
settings.description: Open the Bot Items Board once, the next time the plugin starts. It turns itself off after opening.

settings.title: Archive requests after (days)
settings.description: A request whose items are all closed moves under Archived this many days after the last one closed. A new or reopened item brings it back. 0 never archives.

settings.title: Board folder
settings.description: Where the board's one file lives, registered in Orca as a folder project. Empty: the OS's app data folder (Linux ~/.local/share/orca-items-board, macOS ~/Library/Application Support/orca-items-board, Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\orca-items-board).

settings.title: Hide the board folder in the sidebar
settings.description: The board's folder project holds only the board file, so it's hidden from Orca's sidebar. Turn off to list it.
